summary.en: Planetary Kp remains low. Last-180 maximum 1.67, published window maximum 2.00. Still well below G1 (Kp 5).
summary.zh: 行星 Kp 維持低位。近 180 筆最大 1.67，公開視窗最大 2.00。仍遠低於 G1（Kp 5）。

evidence.method: Used the latest complete 1-minute estimated Kp sample. Window start approx 03:03 UTC. F10.7 omitted due to possible stale noon records.
evidence.limitations: 1-minute estimated Kp is a nowcast, not the final official 3-hour Kp; values can be revised.
